template_data.headline_html: Five pricing mistakes that quietly kill your GSA margins.

items.title: No negotiation headroom
items.sub: GSA COs negotiate down from commercial price — no room built in means you lose before you start.

items.title: Ignoring Price Reductions Clause
items.sub: Give a commercial client a better rate? Your GSA price must match — or you're in violation.

items.title: Pricing too low to win
items.sub: Cheap rates signal inexperience, make delivery unprofitable, and attract auditor attention.

items.title: Wrong labor category mapping
items.sub: Mismatched SINs put your rates next to competitors doing entirely different work.

items.title: No Economic Price Adjustment
items.sub: Without an escalation clause, inflation locks your margins in place for the life of the contract.
